President Trump’s treatment of President Zelenskyy in the Oval Office was an embarrassment to our nation. The President is shamefully abandoning our allies and our democratic values.

I will continue to #StandWithUkraine alongside @HouseForeign.

The GOP budget scheme hands hundreds of billions in tax breaks to billionaire donors like Elon Musk, while ripping Medicaid coverage from millions.

💰 CEOs and wealthy heirs get free handouts.
📈 Everyday Americans get higher costs, fewer doctors, and closed hospitals. https://t.co/ai847NkJl9
Saddened to learn the news of President Biden’s diagnosis. I am confident he will meet this challenge with determination, strength and resilience. Keeping him and his family in my prayers.

The reality of Trump’s 'Big Beautiful Bill' in Maryland:

🩺 1.5M+ could lose Medicaid coverage, including 400K+ in rural communities
👩‍⚕️ Shortage of providers
⏲️ Longer waits for care

House and Senate Democrats are united in fighting back. https://t.co/aBcQq2M5Lr

The Trump-GOP budget would gut Medicaid by over $700 billion, forcing hospitals to close, cutting off care, and driving up unpaid hospital bills.

That means providers will lose their jobs, and lives will be lost. We won't let this happen. #SaveOurHospitals https://t.co/DyL32fjQjH

🚨 50 Senate Republicans just voted to take away your health care.

Now it’s up to the House to stop it. Every member of @HouseGOP should vote NO. https://t.co/TRW2fpibHK
I’m voting NO on Trump's bill to protect your access to the health care you deserve. https://t.co/sSxqmUvkn4

A federal court has temporarily blocked the GOP’s attempt to defund Planned Parenthood.

This is an important step forward, but the fight to protect reproductive health care is far from over. We can't stop until every patient can get the care they need. https://t.co/YbtZ2VUQ54

House Republicans voted to cut Medicaid, kick 17 million Americans off their health care, and take food away from millions more, all to give tax breaks to their billionaire donors.

Every single House Democrat voted NO on Trump’s One Big, Ugly Bill—and the fight isn't over. https://t.co/uIL6RDcSwf

Medicaid helps fund our nursing workforce.

I met with @ANANursingWorld to discuss how cuts in the Republican budget will lead to staff shortages & longer wait times.

Thanks for the stethoscope—a powerful reminder that nurses are the heartbeat of our health care system. 🩺 https://t.co/ImiLVyLYp9

Wrapped the Baltimore City Federal Delegation Meeting with @MayorBMScott, @ChrisVanHollen, @Sen_Alsobrooks, and @RepKweisiMfume.

From housing and healthcare to transportation and infrastructure, we’re working together to protect federal support for Baltimore. https://t.co/Wnk0CNjJG2
✅ FACT: The more people who have access to health care, the better it is for everyone. https://t.co/J2Zjn7f1LX

Day 200 without a vote to lower costs for American families.

Instead, Trump’s GOP is hiking tariffs, gutting food assistance, and driving up health care and utility costs. 

Families deserve more. https://t.co/Xi5RDSQ8hq

Find a cooling center and more resources here:  

🔗 Baltimore County: https://t.co/17NJmjd5lp 

🔗 Carroll County: https://t.co/8EZcutTi58

Happy 60th birthday to Medicare and Medicaid!

Millions of Americans rely on these critical lifelines to stay healthy. That’s why I’m committed to protecting and expanding access to health care for every American. https://t.co/mEszwOeXnJ

Vaccines save lives and keep our community healthy.

This National Immunization Awareness Month, I’m committed to protecting research and coverage for vaccines. https://t.co/GRyNVtNu31

Proud to support Maryland innovation—right here in #MD02!

From cutting-edge diagnostics to global public health initiatives, @BDandCo is improving lives while employing 2K Marylanders.

Thanks to the BD team for the warm welcome and continued commitment to innovation! 🔬 https://t.co/jzLB5XY60a

Maryland is protecting vaccine access amid uncertainty from the Trump Admin. 💉

Marylanders can get flu & COVID shots without a prescription, and insurance will keep covering recommended vaccines. Public health must be guided by science, not politics. 

🔗https://t.co/dPnJtyFRlH https://t.co/jK7UnmKD0a

Today marks 257 days without action on the cost of living crisis.

If Trump & Republicans let health subsidies expire, premiums will skyrocket 93%, stripping coverage from 5M+ Americans and hiking costs for millions more. Families can’t afford this chaos. https://t.co/lTfqnD3Y6E

#TeamMaryland is urging @EPA to maintain its landmark 2009 Endangerment Finding, which states that greenhouse gases endanger public health—a finding based on science and facts.

Rolling it back would fuel climate change, harm Marylanders, and give polluters a free pass. https://t.co/MgcL9ypTtc

Passing a budget is our most basic job—but Republicans refuse to negotiate in good faith. Their plan raises costs & slashes healthcare, and they won’t come to the table to discuss it.

Democrats are fighting for a bipartisan deal to keep the government open & protect families. https://t.co/kymE0SXxBO

Thank you to the #MD02 seniors who joined our first-ever Cup of Joe with Congressman Johnny O! ☕️

We had a great conversation about the work we’re doing in Congress to lower costs and protect healthcare & Social Security for our seniors and all Americans. https://t.co/7nuCmlExFd

Republicans are playing politics with your health care.

If they don’t act now, vital tax credits expire Oct 1—premiums will skyrocket and patients with cancer or chronic illness will pay the price.

Democrats stand united in the fight to protect your care. https://t.co/46b7lVFRf5

I’m in DC ready to vote for a bipartisan budget that keeps the government open, protects health care, and funds commitments like the Key Bridge.

But the GOP plan on the table would gut these basic priorities. Republicans must work in good faith to deliver a responsible budget. https://t.co/7i80kCPDvf

During Trump’s 2018 government shutdown, 420,000 federal workers were forced to work without pay.

I cosponsored @Sen_Alsobrooks & @RepSarahElfreth’s Help FEDS Act to ensure that during a shutdown, these workers can apply for unemployment insurance to help stay afloat. https://t.co/pgpvhuoNop
